title: Paperless Banking: Why Hunter Green Requires E-Statements
summary: This document explains that Hunter Green accounts require e-statements, outlining benefits (faster access, centralized searchable archives, reduced paper mailings) and instructions to ensure you receive notices (confirm email/notification preferences, whitelist sender addresses, check spam filters). It also states that a sustainability impact report is delivered monthly and is available in the same digital documents center as your statements.
